## Summary

Describe the skill change and the reusable problem it solves.

## Checks

- [ ] Skill names are unique and match their directory names.
- [ ] Frontmatter descriptions state triggers and boundaries.
- [ ] Relative references resolve.
- [ ] Examples contain no private paths, identifiers, or repository assumptions.
- [ ] Third-party material has clear authorship and licence information.
- [ ] `README.md` reflects the current skill list.
- [ ] `npx skills add . --list` discovers the intended skills.
